title: Album Cover with Man on Cliff and Goats
coreRelationships: The man on the cliff is the central human figure, positioned high and looking down.
The cliff dominates the left and bottom portions of the image, providing a dramatic setting.
The water and distant city provide a sense of expansive landscape and civilization afar.
The goats are integrated into the rocky landscape, adding an element of nature and perhaps symbolism.
The moon and stars illuminate the dark sky, creating a celestial backdrop.
